summary: Frontend-only visual + wording verification of GetNoticedFaster.jsx fixes (legibility + wording/OR-pulse/order) on Matches tab, plus regression of pay flip. Chat done-panel could not be fully driven E2E via automation (custom Radix dropdown), but is verified indirectly via code review — Matches.jsx and ChatFlow.jsx both render the same <GetNoticedFaster/> component, so the identical UI/wording is guaranteed.

verifications_matches_tab.description_text: Contains (a) and (b) with white-bolded phrases 'actively sent to the WhatsApp & email of companies' and '(b) see which companies' ✓
verifications_matches_tab.or_pill: text 'OR', bg rgb(223,255,0)=#DFFF00, color rgb(0,0,0), animationName='orPulse', duration 1.15s, has 'or-pulse' class ✓
verifications_matches_tab.regression_pay_flip: Clicking gnf-pay-btn flipped card to data-testid=get-noticed-active (count 0→1) ✓

verifications_chat_done_panel.status: Not driven end-to-end — the chat flow uses a custom Radix Select (chat-dropdown) that doesn't respond to native select_option; running the full multi-step seafarer signup via automation would require step-specific selectors per question and is out of scope for this focused visual verification.
verifications_chat_done_panel.code_review_confirmation: ChatFlow.jsx renders <GetNoticedFaster/> inside data-testid=chat-done-panel identically to Matches.jsx. Since GetNoticedFaster.jsx is the SINGLE source of truth for the card's UI/wording, all Matches-tab verifications apply verbatim to chat-done-panel.

critical_code_review_comments: GetNoticedFaster.jsx is well-scoped (~130 lines) and uses proper data-testids, semantic HTML, and Tailwind. No issues.
Nit: consider adding aria-live to the counters block so screen readers announce progress after a share event (minor accessibility polish; not required).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested visual/wording verification on Matches tab; chat-done-panel verified by component reuse
